info.title: SpaceFlow API
info.description: Smart office booking and 3D workplace management API. All responses are JSON. Errors use the shape `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access token
Set a new password using a reset token
Activate an invited account by setting a password
Guest mode: create a private demo sandbox and sign in without an account

get.summary: Current user profile, roles and permissions
OIDC callback: exchanges the code and starts a SpaceFlow session

delete.summary: Remove a favorite (by favorite id or resource id)

get.summary: A colleague's seat for today (respects privacy preference)
Floors of a building (published only for employees)
Floor map: plan, map objects, zones, resources (+availability when a window is given)
List seats and rooms with filters (+availability when startAt/endAt given)
Availability state for many resources over a window
Find me a seat: ranked available seats for a window

delete.summary: Archive a seats (soft delete; history is kept)
Archive a meeting rooms (soft delete; history is kept)

get.summary: List reservations (own, or any with reservation:manage-any)

post.summary: Create a reservation (single, multi-day or recurring)
Check in (optionally with the QR/confirmation code)
Check out early and release the resource
Approve or reject a pending reservation

get.summary: QR code (PNG data URL) encoding the check-in link
Global search across buildings, floors, seats, rooms, amenities, facilities and employees

post.summary: Issue a short-lived ticket for the SSE stream (EventSource cannot send headers)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream: availability.changed, reservation.updated, notification.created, floorplan.published
List uploaded 3D models and floor-plan images

post.summary: Upload a GLB model or floor-plan image (multipart: file, kind)

get.summary: Stream the asset file (same-origin download; never executed)

put.summary: Attach or detach a GLB building model

patch.summary: Update a floor (name, number, publish state)

get.summary: Floor plan draft incl. unlinked resources

put.summary: Save floor plan draft (replaces map objects; keeps resources + history)

post.summary: Validate and publish the floor plan
Unpublish the floor plan (floor becomes hidden to employees)
Import seats or rooms from CSV (multipart: file, type=seats|rooms, dryRun=true|false)

get.summary: Export seats or rooms as CSV (?type=seats|rooms)
Resolve the effective policy for a building + resource type

post.summary: Cancel any reservation with a reason (audited)

get.summary: Investigate reservations that touch the same resource within a window
Admin overview: totals, occupancy, volume, utilization, peaks, rates, top resources

put.summary: Enable/disable an integration and store its non-secret config
